detail.longDescription: I am trying to run a python script using Octave's system() function. When I call the python script from terminal source tabpfn_env/bin/activate cd ~/tabpfn_env python3 tabpfn_for_regression.py the script runs just fine, however, in Octave system('source tabpfn_env/bin/activate') gives the following error sh: 1: source: not found ans = 127 and so, failing at the first hurdle, I can't execute the python script. What is the correct syntax to call this sequence of commands from Octave?
